walls.notes: 13 Bene't St (listed, Q26419228), at the corner of Free School Lane. Timber-framed house, white render with black-painted trim, jettied at the 1st and 2nd floors. The steep tiled gable faces Bene't St. Ground floor is a charcoal-painted restaurant front (Smokeworks, named on a hanging vertical banner, not on a fascia): a large multi-pane window, a central door, then a larger multi-pane window to the west corner post, with a white panel below. Upper floors have one small-paned sash per floor in a single column, slightly east of centre. A third sash sits in the gable. The rest of the gable wall is blank. Free School Lane nameplate at the corner.
